blocks.title: Company profile
texts: BUZUD is the health-products brand under CHUNG YIP HOLDING PTE. LTD.; this website is operated by CHUNG YIP HOLDING PTE. LTD. and is responsible for product sales and after-sales service.

CHUNG YIP HOLDING PTE is a Singapore-based diversified investment management firm dedicated to identifying high-potential assets, frontier technology projects, and long-term growth opportunities across the Asia-Pacific region. Guided by our core philosophy of “Global Vision, Local Execution,” we leverage Singapore’s strategic position as a global financial center and innovation hub to build resilient, innovation-driven, and future-oriented portfolios that deliver sustainable long-term value for investors.

We uphold a long-term investment philosophy, with a strategic focus on high-growth sectors including industrial real estate, new building materials, education, AI healthcare, digital infrastructure, and intelligent software ecosystems. We continuously develop cross-sector, vertically integrated investment capabilities and resource integration expertise. At the same time, we place strong emphasis on ESG-oriented sustainable development opportunities, promoting deeper integration between capital, technology, and industry. Leveraging our professional team’s twenty years of experience in the Asia-Pacific market, we are committed to becoming a strategic bridge connecting capital, industry, and innovative technology.

columns.heading: AI + education

columns.text: CHUNG YIP cooperates with BUZUD, a well-known home-grown Singaporean healthcare brand, to jointly explore innovative applications and solutions for artificial intelligence technology in the healthcare field.
